ἔπ: ἐπί — to, towards; prep. + acc., following its noun with accent thrown back (ἔπι) and elided (ἔπ’)
ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα), elided (ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠμύει: ἠμύω — bow, droop, sink down; pres. 3 sg.
ἠϊόνος: ἠϊών — shore, beach; fem. gen. sg.
ἡμέτεραί: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἥρωες: ἥρως — hero; masc. voc. pl. (same as nom.), in address: ’heroes!’
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’)
ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarian, of the Icarian Sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἰλαδὸν: ἰλαδόν — in troops, in companies; adv.
ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’
ἱζόντων: ἵζω — sit down, take a seat; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’as they sat down’
ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἵστατ: ἵστημι — set; mid. stand, rise; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵστατ’ = ἵστατο): ’rose, stood up’
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀτρύνουσ: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ὀτρύνουσ’ = ὀτρύνουσα): ’urging’
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
ὄσσα: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report; Ossa, Rumour personified as a messenger of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
ὅμαδος: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. nom. sg.
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., also + gen.: ποδῶν ὑπένερθε ’beneath their feet’
ὑπέρμορα: ὑπέρμορα — beyond fate, contrary to destiny; adv. (neut. pl. of ὑπέρμορος)
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I lost’
ὤρορ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 3 sg. (reduplicated ὤρορε), elided (ὤρορ’ = ὤρορε)
ᾕρεον: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρουν); with ὑπό in tmesis, ’they took away from under’
εὐχωλὴν: εὐχωλή — vaunt, boast; a thing to boast of, triumph; fem. acc. sg.

__broaden__.αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη)
__broaden__.κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. acc. sg. (object of τίθει) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’power, might’ (τοῦ κράτος ἐστὶ μέγιστον)
__broaden__.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’)
__broaden__.τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’)
__broaden__.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’)
__broaden__.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; prep. + dat./acc./gen., accented before the enclitic τε; ἐπί τε … καί ’both to … and’ · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπί τ’ … ἠμύει ’bows down upon’)
